solution_summary: Rituals modernized core business workflows around Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Dynamics 365, and Dynamics 365 Finance because Rituals creates body, beauty, and home products with a conscience. Instead of relying on fragmented local systems, the organization now runs shared finance, customer, service, retail, or supply-chain processes through a cloud platform that acts as a common system of record. Operational transactions move through Dynamics-based workflows, while supporting analytics and low-code extensions keep reporting, exception handling, and local process needs inside the same Microsoft estate rather than recreating new point solutions. That architecture gives business teams a consistent data backbone for daily execution and leadership insight, reducing manual reconciliation and creating room to scale.
